# gitmoap_repository_release_asset (Resource)

Reserves room for a file of the size you declare and returns a short-lived URL to upload it to with an HTTP `PUT` of exactly that size and content type. The asset can be downloaded once the upload is confirmed. Developers and above may add assets; the release must exist, the name must be unused on it, and the size must be within both the per-file limit and the organization's remaining storage.

The token needs `release:create`, `release:read` and `release:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

resource "gitmoap_repository_tag" "v1" {
  repo_id  = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  tag_name = "v1.0.0"
  target   = "main"
  message  = "Version 1.0.0"
}

resource "gitmoap_repository_release" "v1" {
  repo_id  = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  tag_name = gitmoap_repository_tag.v1.tag_name
  name     = "1.0.0"
}

# Registers a file on a release. Upload the file itself to upload_url, at exactly this size.
resource "gitmoap_repository_release_asset" "cli" {
  repo_id      = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  tag_name     = gitmoap_repository_release.v1.tag_name
  name         = "api-cli-linux-amd64.tar.gz"
  content_type = "application/gzip"
  size         = 5242880
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `size` (Number) The file's exact size in bytes. An upload of any other size is rejected.
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name

### Read-Only

- `asset_id` (String) Asset ID
- `created_at` (String)
- `state` (String) Whether a release file has been uploaded: `uploading` (an upload URL was issued, but the upload
has not been confirmed yet) or `available`.
- `upload_url` (String) A presigned URL to upload the file to with an HTTP `PUT`. It accepts only a file of the
declared size, and expires shortly.
- `url` (String) A presigned URL to download the file from. It expires shortly.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id, tag_name and asset_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_release_asset.example "<repo_id>/<tag_name>/<asset_id>"
```
